system.description:
Your reflexes are honed to a razor's edge. Even as you watch others begin to move, you spring into motion and finish your own act before they can respond.

Expend a single Blood Trait to preempt any physical action taken in the same turn, provided you are aware of it (a face-to-face attack, yes; an unseen sniper, no). You might draw and fire on someone reaching for a hidden gun instead of merely dodging, or throw yourself between an aggressor and an ally. If you try to preempt another character using Celerity or a similar speed-enhancing power, whoever has the higher degree of Celerity acts first. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
